resource.title: Electromagnetics and Applications (MIT 6.013, Spring 2009) — MIT OpenCourseWare
resource.access: MIT OpenCourseWare 免费开放，无需注册；页面提供完整讲义（Lecture Notes）、开放教材（Open Textbook）、作业与解答、考试与演示视频
resource.covers: 按大纲原文覆盖：静态与动态电磁场、能量与功率；介质内部与界面上的场与波（对应反射与折射）；空间与传输线中的辐射和传播；传输线（含失配与调谐）；波导与隐失波；谐振器；导线/口径/阵列天线；光学与声学器件类比。即简介的 8 个知识点都有对应。不含深入的波导模场数值求解与复杂谐振腔设计

courses.prereq_text: Prerequisites: ELENG 64, MATH 53, and MATH 54; PHYSICS 7B or equivalent that covers AC circuits and electromagnetics up to Maxwell's equations.
courses.scope_text: Catalog Description: Review of static electric and magnetic fields and applications; Maxwell's equations; transmission lines; propagation and reflection of plane waves; introduction to guided waves, microwave networks, and radiation and antennas. Minilabs on statics, transmission lines, and waves. Explanation of cellphone antennas, WiFi communication, and other wireless technologies.
courses.hours_text: Units: 4 — Spring: 3.0 hours of lecture, 1.0 hours of discussion, and 2.0 hours of laboratory per week

courses.prereq_text: Prerequisites: 18.01, 18.02, or equivalent; 8.01, 8.02, or equivalent; and 6.002 and 6.00. More specifically they include complex numbers, vector operators, simple matrix operations, basic calculus, RLC circuits, Maxwell's equations, and Fourier transforms.
courses.scope_text: Understand the big ideas of electromagnetics, including: Static and dynamic electromagnetic (EM) fields, energy, and power; EM fields and waves within and at the boundaries of media; EM radiation and propagation in space and within transmission lines; Circuit behavior of simple EM devices and transmission lines ... Outcomes: ... Resistors, capacitors, inductors, transformers, transmission lines, and resonators ... Sinusoids and transients on TEM lines with mismatched impedances and tuning; EM fields at planar boundaries and within waveguides, including evanescence; ... Wire, aperture, and array antennas for transmission and reception
courses.hours_text: Lectures: 2 sessions / week, 1 hour / session; Recitations: 2 sessions / week, 1 hour / session; Tutorials: 1 session / week, 1 hour / session

courses.prereq_text: An introductory course in electromagnetics (PHYSICS 43, PHYSICS 63, PHYSICS 81, or EE 42), and a solid background in vector calculus (CME 100, CME 102, or MATH 52, with MATH 52 being an ideal prerequisite) is recommended.
courses.scope_text: Introduction to electromagnetism and Maxwell's equations in static and dynamic regimes. Electrostatics and magnetostatics: Gauss's, Coulomb's, Faraday's, Ampere's, Biot-Savart's laws. Electric and magnetic potentials. Boundary conditions. Electric and magnetic field energy. Electrodynamics: Wave equation; Electromagnetic waves; Phasor form of Maxwell's equations. Solution of the wave equation in 1D

notes: 候选判断依据：M.1.4.4 由 Berkeley EE 117 的 MATH 53 必修支持（MATH 53 原文明确含 'Vector calculus. Theorems of Green, Gauss, and Stokes.'），MIT 6.013 的 18.02、Stanford EE 142 的 vector calculus 建议也一致 → supported。N.1.2 见 EE 117 'PHYSICS 7B or equivalent that covers AC circuits and electromagnetics up to Maxwell's equations'、MIT 6.013 的 8.02、Stanford 的 PHYSICS 43 建议 → supported。M.1.8（复分析）三门课的先修里都没有：Berkeley MATH 53/54 不含复变，MIT 6.013 只在先修说明里列 'complex numbers' 而非复变函数课程，故 not_mentioned。M.2.2（偏微分方程）也没有作为先修课出现；Berkeley MATH 53 课程大纲末尾有一节 'Examples of Partial Differential Equations'、MIT 6.013 的教学目标里把 'Partial differential equations' 列为本课练习的数学技能，但都不是先修课名，故记 not_mentioned 而非 recommended。另核对到 MIT 6.2300 Electromagnetics Waves and Applications（https://catalog.mit.edu/subjects/6/，3-5-4 units，'Prereq: Calculus II (GIR) and Physics II (GIR)'），其内容原文含 'dynamic solutions for Maxwell's equations; electromagnetic power and energy, waves in media, metallic and dielectric waveguides, radiation, and diffraction; resonance; filters'，且明写 '6.2000 and 6.3000 are recommended but not required'，因每技能限 3 门未列入 courses，但它支持 H.1.3 的 recommended。
